title: PXDepth: Pixel-Space Modeling for Structure Preserving Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent monocular depth estimators achieve strong zero-shot generalization, yet often struggle to preserve fine-grained structures and object boundaries. We attribute this limitation to the prevalent combination of large-patch ViT encoders and convolutional decoders, as coarse tokenization can weaken pixel-level cues that upsampling cannot fully recover. To address this issue, we propose PXDepth, a discriminative monocular depth model that separates global context modeling from pixel-level depth prediction. Specifically, a large-patch ViT captures global scene context, while a pixel-space predictor composed of Context-Modulated Pixel Transformer blocks maintains high-resolution spatial representations throughout depth estimation. This design preserves fine structures and sharp boundaries without sacrificing global depth consistency. translated_title: PXDepth：基于像素空间建模的结构保持单目深度估计
translated_abstract: 最近的单目深度估计器在零样本泛化方面表现强劲，但往往难以保持细粒度结构和物体边界。我们将这一局限性归因于大块ViT编码器与卷积解码器的普遍组合，因为粗粒度的标记化可能削弱像素级线索，而上采样无法完全恢复这些线索。为解决此问题，我们提出了PXDepth，一种判别性单目深度模型，将全局上下文建模与像素级深度预测分离。具体来说，大块ViT捕获全局场景上下文，而由上下文调制像素Transformer块组成的像素空间预测器在整个深度估计过程中保持高分辨率空间表示。这种设计在保持全局深度一致性的同时，保留了精细结构和尖锐边界。在各种零样本基准测试中，PXDepth将忠实的局部几何与具有竞争力的全局深度相结合。
tldr: PXDepth通过分离全局上下文建模和像素级预测，利用上下文调制像素Transformer块保持高分辨率空间表示，从而在单目深度估计中保留精细结构和物体边界。
en_tdlr: PXDepth preserves fine structures and object boundaries in monocular depth estimation by separating global context modeling from pixel-level prediction, using Context-Modulated Pixel Transformer blocks to maintain high-resolution spatial representations.
